description: Concurrent Beta 1 feature-completion wave (US-561..US-581): close the audited Lando 3 → 4 functionality gaps before feature freeze. Un-gate the four spec'd Landofile keys (env_file, toolingDefaults, commandAliases, events-as-tasks); complete the §6.12.1 service catalog (rabbitmq, minio, localstack, mailpit, mailhog, tomcat, varnish, dotnet, mssql, phpmyadmin); PHP depth per §6.12.5 (8.5, via:, composer:, xdebug:, db_client:) plus Compose configs: realization; recipe composition (§8.8.15) + option parity (§8.8.16) + laravel/symfony/backdrop/joomla/mean recipes; bundled @lando/sql helpers on DataMover (§10.7); residual guides and parity-audit refresh. Out of scope: hoster connectors (4.1 RemoteSource), custom SSH-key mounts (rejected), staged §8.8.10 recipes, image save/load.
